business_summary: Shenzhen Bioeasy Biotechnology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides rapid food safety testing reagents and instruments in China and internationally. The company offers test kits, including veterinary, melamine, mycotoxin, pesticide, adulteration, ATP, vitamin, and others; equipment, such as incubator, reader, suitcase lab, automatic pressers, and others; and materials comprising pretreatment column, certified reference, and quality control. It also provides specialized solutions, which include multi-mode precision detection, project plan for specialized equipment, AI-powered fully automated grain comprehensive testing workstation, digital food safety automatic detection, rapid testing laboratory, smart supervision, and comprehensive solution for rapid testing. In addition, the company offers software platforms, such as smart grain depot, traceability, orchard, datian, tea garden, and park project, as well as digital village project and agricultural and rural data projects. Its products are used in dairy, cereal and feed, fruit and vegetable, meat and seafood, honey and egg, laboratory, animal health, and other industries. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
